hypotheses.justification: `hm` follows from the other hypotheses. The variable `[Fact p.Prime]` is an argument of the theorem, because `p` appears in the type of `O`. If `m = 0`, then `hmp : Nat.Coprime 0 p` gives `p = 1` by `Nat.coprime_zero_left` (used in Mathlib's `Data/Nat/GCD/Basic.lean`). That contradicts `(Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt`. So `0 < m` can be rebuilt at the start of the proof: `have hm : 0 < m := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by rintro rfl; exact (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt.ne' (Nat.coprime_zero_left _ |>.mp hmp))`. The rest of the proof then runs unchanged.
